name: Split editor
desc: A code editor beside a file list you can resize, both filling the window: open a folder, pick a file, edit with colours and suggestions, Ctrl+S to save. The burger hides the list (a state).

windows.name: Main
windows.title: Editor
windows.menus:
&File
    &New | Ctrl+N | NewFile()
    &Open a folder... | Ctrl+O | PickFolder()
    &Save | Ctrl+S | SaveFile()
    -
    E&xit | Alt+F4 | g.Close()
&View
    &Files | Ctrl+B | TogglePane()
    &Word wrap | Alt+Z | ToggleWrap()
windows.status:
msg | Ready | grow icon=E943
lang | AutoHotkey | w=110 right
size | | w=100 right
windows.titleitems:
pane | burger | | tip="Files (Ctrl+B)" class=morph toggle | TogglePane()
brand | text | Editor |
gap | spacer | |
save | glyph | E74E | right tip="Save (Ctrl+S)" | SaveFile()
windows.states:
panes: files.Visible = 1, sp1.Visible = 1
nopanes: files.Visible = 0, sp1.Visible = 0
windows.hotkeys:
^s | active | own | SaveFile
^n | active | own | NewFile
^o | active | own | PickFolder
^b | active | own | TogglePane
!z | active | own | ToggleWrap

kids.name: ed
kids.arg:
; Pick a file on the left, or start typing.
; Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+B hides the list, Alt+Z wraps.

events.name: Change
events.code:
global Dirty
Dirty := true
g.Status("size", StrLen(value) " chars")
